subject.title: feat(hosting): add profile inspection and conformance tooling

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the public Plugin SDK readiness callback, operator-selected readiness criteria, and versioned Standard Hosting Profiles as one supported V1 deployment contract?
rationale: This choice defines durable public Plugin SDK, CLI, configuration, readiness, and release-automation behavior; code review cannot determine whether maintainers want to support that contract long term.

options.title: Approve the V1 contract and stack
options.body: Accept the public readiness/profile direction, then review and land the prerequisite PRs before this catalog, validator, and release-evidence facility.

options.title: Keep readiness internal for now
options.body: Decline the public Plugin SDK and profile contract, and ask for a narrower internal or documentation-only follow-up without new supported configuration or API surface.

options.title: Defer the hosting-profile program
options.body: Pause the stack until RFC and ownership decisions establish a maintainer-supported deployment contract.

recommendation.title: Approve the V1 contract and stack
recommendation.body: Accept the public readiness/profile direction, then review and land the prerequisite PRs before this catalog, validator, and release-evidence facility.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor authored the connected readiness, criteria, profile, validation, and conformance-evidence stack and can supply the requested contract and proof details for maintainer review.
